meta.name: test-and-deploy
meta.description: Make sure to use this skill whenever the user mentions running tests, executing npm tests, checking lint rules, linting, code formatting, git pushing, pushing to GitHub, or deploying commits to the remote repository. This skill ensures a secure pre-push pipeline by validating tests and linter output prior to any git push.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 推送代码前自动运行测试和 lint 检查
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你希望每次推送代码前都自动通过测试和格式检查
copy.tagline_en: Run tests and lint checks automatically before pushing code
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want tests and lint to run automatically before every push

howto.what: 装上后，当用户要求跑测试、lint 或推送时，Claude 会先确认测试和 lint 脚本存在，依次执行 lint、测试和构建；失败即停下让用户修复；全部通过后递增版本号、更新版本日志，提交代码，并在用户明确同意后才推送到 GitHub。
howto.when: 当用户提到运行测试、执行 lint、推送到 GitHub 等测试或部署相关请求时触发。

say.text: 运行测试和 lint，通过后帮我提交代码。
say.note: 先执行 lint、测试和构建，失败会停下。

say.text: 跑测试和 lint，通过后递增补丁版本并提交。
say.note: 没有指定版本级别时会自动加补丁号。

say.text: 检查代码并准备推送到 GitHub，先做测试和 lint 验证。
say.note: 推送前必须征得你的明确同意。

howto.what_en: When tests/lint/push are requested, Claude validates lint, tests, and build; halts on failure; on success bumps version, logs it, commits, and pushes after explicit user approval.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user mentions running tests, executing lint, or pushing to GitHub, among other test/deploy actions.

say_en.text: Run tests and lint, then commit the code if they pass.
say_en.note: It runs lint, tests, and build; stops on failure.

say_en.text: Run tests and lint, then bump the patch version and commit.
say_en.note: If no level is specified, it auto-increments patch.

say_en.text: Check code and prep for a GitHub push, running tests and lint first.
say_en.note: It asks for explicit confirmation before pushing.
